About this item

Product details

Upgrade your everyday comfort with these No Boundaries Fleece Joggers—perfect for lounging, running errands, or layering up for chilly days. Designed with soft-brushed fleece on the inside, these joggers offer warmth without the bulk, helping to keep you snug all day. Designed with a relaxed, slightly tapered fit, they offer a laid-back vibe that’s easy to wear with our matching Oversized Fleece Sweatshirts (sold separately). Whether you're unwinding at home or heading out, you'll love the warmth, ease, and everyday style these joggers offer. Only at Walmart.
